reasoning_content: So Navigation.vue only imports the Sensor type and doesn't import NavUser, which means MainPage's dependency tree doesn't include NavUser.vue. Let me check where NavUser is actually used — probably in AppSidebar or AppShell. And I need to check whether AppShell/AppSidebar are reachable from MainPage.

action.command: cd /workspace && grep -rn "NavUser\|AppShell\|AppSidebar" resources/js --include='*.vue' --include='*.ts' -l; echo ---; grep -E '^import' resources/js/components/AppShell.vue resources/js/components/AppSidebar.vue 2>/dev/null | head -20
